method: Original PC handlers, original0x52fcb0 intent writes and0x534e10 route selection, original locator/string/numeric/expression/RNG/vector helpers. CRT formatting and movement-token/completion callbacks are explicit fixture services.
limits: Synthetic valid path/node/actor relationships; no actual world pathfinder, motion integration or terrain stepping.
Formation record is null in this suite; native formation-mode delegation is a separate boundary.
Movement token callback consumes walk/run/tiptoe using fixture markers, not claimed runtime speed-mode semantics.
Expression evaluation executes original PC code in fixtures; portable general expression evaluation remains a supplied service.
Finite scalar fixtures; arbitrary x87 rounding, NaN/overflow and bad pointer domains are excluded.
